verdict: Missingness depends on observed variables (missing vs present: median quantity 1 vs 6 (large effect); median price 3.36 vs 1.95 (medium effect); UK share 98.8% vs 89.9% (small effect)), so it is NOT MCAR. It is consistent with MAR (e.g. guest / unregistered checkouts); MNAR cannot be ruled out from the data alone. Rows without an ID cannot be attributed to a customer, so they are dropped from customer-level analysis; results therefore describe registered customers only.
